name: Gemfibrozil
description: A fibrate approved for severe hypertriglyceridaemia and for reduction of coronary heart disease risk in a specific dyslipidaemic population. Its statin interaction is more pronounced than that of fenofibrate.

systems.note: Transaminase elevation and cholelithiasis are labelled.
Marked myopathy risk when combined with a statin; labelled.
Haemoglobin and leukocyte decline are labelled early in therapy.

monitors.why: Marked myopathy risk in statin combination.
Labelled decline in the first months of therapy.
